body.en: Not a step — it runs under every one of them.
body.zh: 這不是一個步驟，而是貫穿每一步的前提。

body.en: Between unrelated tasks — and when the same thing has been corrected twice, clear and write one new prompt
body.zh: 不相關的任務之間；同一件事糾正兩次還是錯，也清掉重下一個新 prompt

body.en: Roll the code or conversation back to an earlier prompt
body.zh: 把程式碼或對話退回先前的某個 prompt

summary.en: Write down the team's standards — project structure, design patterns, code security, database design — and wire them into the AI workflow so generated code meets them.
summary.zh: 建立專案架構、設計模式、程式碼安全與資料庫設計的開發規範，並整合進 AI 工作流程，讓 AI 產生的程式碼符合團隊標準。

body.en: Keep it short: only what Claude can't find by reading the repo.
body.zh: 保持精簡：只寫 Claude 讀程式碼也找不到的事。

body.en: Standards and procedures, read in full only when a task calls for it.
body.zh: 規範與流程，任務需要時才讀取全文。

body.en: For a rule with zero exceptions — applied every time, whatever the model decides.
body.zh: 給零例外的規則：不管模型怎麼判斷，每次都會執行。

body.en: allow / ask / deny rules; deny holds in every permission mode.
body.zh: allow / ask / deny 規則；deny 在任何權限模式下都有效。

summary.en: Claude asks questions until the requirements, system design and implementation approach add up to a spec — including what's out of scope. Every feature gets one, and together they become the agent's project knowledge base.
summary.zh: 讓 Claude 反問，直到需求、系統設計與實作規劃能拼成一份 spec，包含不做的範圍。每個功能都有一份，累積成 Coding Agent 的專案知識庫。

body.en: The spec is written to the repo and reviewed before anything else happens.
body.zh: Spec 寫進 repo，經我確認後才進入下一步。

summary.en: Each feature is built in its own worktree and branch, so AI changes never touch the main checkout until they're reviewed.
summary.zh: 每個功能在獨立的 worktree 與分支開發，AI 的修改在審查通過前都碰不到主要工作目錄。

body.en: A separate working directory per branch, sharing one repo.
body.zh: 同一個 repo，每個分支一個獨立的工作目錄。

summary.en: The spec is broken into small tasks, each with the files it touches and how it will be tested. I approve the plan before any code is written.
summary.zh: 把 spec 拆成小任務，每項寫明要改的檔案與測試方式。我核准計畫後才開始寫程式。

body.en: The plan lives next to the spec it came from.
body.zh: 計畫與對應的 spec 放在一起。

summary.en: Each task goes to a fresh subagent with a clean context. Inside every task: write a failing test first, then the code that makes it pass.
summary.zh: 每個任務交給 context 乾淨的新 subagent。每個任務內都先寫會失敗的測試，再寫讓它通過的程式碼。

body.en: One task per subagent, checked before the next one starts.
body.zh: 一個 subagent 負責一個任務，檢查過才進下一項。

body.en: Red → green → refactor; no code without a test that failed first.
body.zh: 紅 → 綠 → 重構；沒有先失敗過的測試，就不寫程式碼。

summary.en: Each task is reviewed as it lands, then the whole diff is reviewed against the spec by a reviewer that never saw the conversation.
summary.zh: 每個任務完成時逐項審查，最後由沒看過這段對話的 reviewer 對照 spec 審查整份 diff。

body.en: Check every requirement in the spec — and skip style.
body.zh: 逐條檢查 spec 的需求，並略過風格問題。

summary.en: With tests green, the branch is merged or opened as a PR — I review it before submitting and have Claude highlight the risks.
summary.zh: 測試全數通過後，合併分支或開 PR；送出前我會先審，並請 Claude 點出潛在風險。

body.en: Then the worktree is cleaned up.

items.code: create a pr for my changes
